---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability for nanolist
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Description

What you would like nanolist to do.

## Use case

The problem this solves and who it helps (someone browsing for tools, a
submitter, a curator reviewing listings, …).

## Proposed solution

How you imagine it working — a site feature, a change to the listing schema,
a workflow change, etc.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why this one.

## Alignment with the values

How this fits the Nano Collective's posture (open source, local-first,
privacy-respecting) — e.g. does it avoid new tracking, keep the site static,
and keep curation transparent?
